show.description: Feared underworld kingpin Nic’s life takes a sharp turn when he meets Kusha, a sheltered girl fleeing her controlling mother. As danger, betrayal, and a police manhunt close in, their unexpected love becomes his path to redemption. But when Nic’s past resurfaces and a traitor destroys his empire, he must choose between vengeance, family, and the woman who awakens his humanity.
